title: crataegus monogyna var. intermedia
intro: Crataegus monogyna var. intermedia, commonly known as Midway hawthorn, is a variant of the Crataegus monogyna species, which is a type of hawthorn tree native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Midway hawthorn are attributed to its ability to dilate blood vessels, improve heart function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which have been shown to contribute to the plant's potential health benefits.
